items.quote: And they made bells of pure gold
items.claim: They made bells of pure gold

items.quote: and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates
items.claim: They put bells between pomegranates on the hem of a robe, arranged round about
items.place: upon the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates

items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses regarding these items and their arrangement
